Remark
[Spatial analyticity] ↗ thm:heat-equation-derivative-estimates 1. ch2:2.3.3-rem-8\group Heat Equation

For each fixed $0<t\le T$, the map $x\mapsto u(x,t)$ is analytic, but $t\mapsto u(x,t)$ need not be analytic \cite{Mikhailov1978}.
